verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official CLI that is built for headless and scripted use. In CI it authenticates via GUSTO_ACCESS_TOKEN and GUSTO_COMPANY_UUID env vars or --token-stdin, and it keeps separate sandbox and production credential slots. When stdout is piped it automatically emits a stable JSON envelope, with documented exit codes, --dry-run, a keyless verified installer and versioned release binaries. Underneath sits a full REST API with idempotency keys, webhooks and demo companies for automated testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage and documented CI pipeline examples; also, agent-mode writes require --confirm and there is no payroll submit command, which limits unattended end-to-end automation.
